verdict.rationale: Raygun documents native repository integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab, which covers the repo-connection part of the story. It also tracks deployments to spot new errors or regressions, but nothing ties issues to specific commits. Missing for 10: suspect-commit attribution on issues, code-owner mapping, linking from a stack frame to the exact line on the default branch, and any detailed or hands-on corroboration of the repo integration.
